_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/habits.json and edit. All patterns are case-insensitive regexes searched in paths (forward slashes), commands, URLs or queries. docs: files or folders, relative to the project or absolute; a reminder fires at session end if a trigger happened and none of its docs changed afterwards. once_per_session (optional): remind at most once per session, for rules that would otherwise fire every turn. tokens (optional, these are the defaults): context warning past context_warn then every context_step tokens; big_output = tool output size (tokens) that gets a nudge. guards (optional, both default true, no config needed): shell_writes blocks heredoc / multi-line echo / Set-Content writes into non-temp files (use Write/Edit); control_chars reports NUL, form feed and other control bytes, invalid UTF-8 and mixed line endings in a just-edited file. experiments (optional): on_command = long-run launches; the first one in a session with no edit to a file matching plan gets a one-time reminder to write the experiment plan (skill experiment-plan); message overrides the default text.
_comment_knowledge: knowledge_paths: path regexes (matched on absolute forward-slash paths) that only the librarian agent (agent-habits:librarian) may write; Edit/Write and shell writes from anyone else are blocked with a pointer to it. knowledge_map: the doc(s) the librarian reads to place a fact. knowledge_audit: input of scripts/kb_audit.py and the librarian-audit skill (files / folders of .md, code_roots searched for cited names and paths, repos whose commits may be cited, report path). to_librarian (on a reminder): its stop message also says to hand findings to the librarian.

block.message: Don't force-push: use --force-with-lease, or ask the user first.

reminders.name: changelog
reminders.message: This session changed user-facing code (src/ edit or a deploy) but CHANGELOG.md has no newer edit. Add a line under Unreleased, or say why this change doesn't need one.

reminders.name: knowledge
reminders.message: This session did research (probes, reference reads, docs lookups) but docs/knowledge/ has no newer edit. Record what was learned (Status + Evidence; tested / researched / guess), or say why nothing new was learned.
